name: alsa-tools
description: The ALSA Tools package contains advanced tools for certain sound cards.

user: rm -rf qlo10k1 echomixer rmedigicontrol Makefile gitcompile

for tool in *; do
  case $tool in
    seq) tool_dir=seq/sbiload ;;
    *) tool_dir=$tool ;;
  esac
  [ -d "$tool_dir" ] || continue
  pushd $tool_dir
    ./configure --prefix=/usr
    make
  popd
done
package:
for tool in *; do
  case $tool in
    seq) tool_dir=seq/sbiload ;;
    *) tool_dir=$tool ;;
  esac
  [ -d "$tool_dir" ] || continue
  pushd $tool_dir
    make install DESTDIR=$DESTDIR
  popd
done
